question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Sonam is current reading the books I gave her for her birthday.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"current"** means happening or being used or done now. (वर्तमान)

 
 
• **Example: **The **current** situation requires immediate attention.
 
 
 
• **"Currently" **is the correct form to use in this context, which means at the present time. (वर्तमान में)
 
 
• **Example: **She is **currently **reading a fascinating book on history.
 
 

Hence, the correct word to use in this context is **'currently' **instead of **'current'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1 - No error **(कोई त्रुटि नहीं): This option suggests that there is no error in the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** The sentence is grammatically correct; there is no error.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - her for her birthday** (उसके जन्मदिन के लिए उसे): This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any grammatical errors.
 
 
• **Example: **I bought a gift for her for her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - the books I gave** (पुस्तकें जो मैंने दीं): This part is also correct and does not contain any errors.
 
 
• **Example:** The books I gave her were well-received.
